guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Visit WheelX and connect your wallet
guide.description: Go to WheelX and connect an EVM wallet like MetaMask or Rabby. First-time connections receive a 1,000 XP newcomer bonus automatically. At the current rate, the base bonus is worth about $0.36.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Fund your wallet with ETH or stablecoins
guide.description: You need real assets to bridge and swap. Grab ETH, USDT, or USDC from Bybit and withdraw to your wallet, or move funds you already hold onto a supported chain using the widget below. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Complete the social quests
guide.description: Open the WheelX quest page and follow WheelX on X, join the Discord server, and join the Telegram channel. Each task pays 20 XP once. These are the cheapest points on the board, so clear them first.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Bridge and swap regularly
guide.description: This is the core XP source. Each completed bridge or swap earns XP based on transaction value, and it stacks with your booster multiplier. Skip Solana-side swaps for now, since those transactions do not count toward XP yet.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Deploy a smart contract
guide.description: WheelX offers a contract deployment tool that pays a flat 50 XP per mainnet deployment. Testnet deployments earn nothing, so use a cheap chain like Base or Ink to keep gas costs below the reward value.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Check in daily with onchain GM
guide.description: The GM feature pays a fixed 3 XP per day for an onchain check-in. It is small, but it keeps your address active and adds up over a long farming window.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Refer friends and redeem dividends
guide.description: Share your referral link from the rewards page. You earn XP 1:1 with everything your referees make from swaps, bridges, deployments, and GM check-ins. Once your redeemable balance clears the $5 minimum, withdraw your USDT dividends on Base.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
